newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares topple 2 pct, downside seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares topple 2 pct, downside seen.

text.p: Austrian shares ended nearly two percent lower on Friday in line with other Eurobourses, and traders said there was room for further downside next week after Sunday's final round of French elections.

Traders predicted further correction at the beginning of next week possibly to 1,250 points, followed by a recovery, but they did not see the index reaching the year high of 1,323.19 points for the time being.
"The uptrend has only just now stopped," said one trader. "New highs will be difficult in the near future," he added.
"Whether we see highs again in the short term I don't know," another said.
The ATX index dropped 24.57 points, or 1.88 percent, to 1,280.02. Among its constituents 18 shares fell, three were unchanged.
The leading decliner was microchip maker AMS, slipping 4.12 percent to 932 schillings.
The June ATX future shed 29 points to end at 1,276 on turnover 1,140 contracts. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
